blocks.tamil_translation: let him change it with his hand; if he has no power (to change it with his hand), let him change it with his tongue. If he has no power for that either, let him know in his heart that it is evil. (Let him grieve in his heart about that evil) This is the weakest degree of Iman”. Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) reports that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَثَلُ الْقَائِمِ عَلي حُدُودِ اللهِ وَالْوَاقِعِ فِيهَا كَمَثَلِ قَوْمٍ اِسْتَهَمُوا عَلي سَفِينَةٍ، فَأَصَابَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَعْلَاهَا وَبَعْضُهُمْ أَسْفَلَهَا، فَكَانَ الَّذِينَ فِي أَسْفَلِهَا إِذَا اسْتَقَوْا مِنَ الْمَاءِ مَرُّوا عَلَي مَنْ فَوْقَهُمْ فَقَالُوا: لَوْ أَنَّا خَرَقْنَا فِي نَصِيبِنَا خَرْقاً وَلَمْ نُؤْذِ مَنْ فَوْقَنَا، فَإِنْ يَتْرُكُوهُمْ وَمَا أَرَادُوا هَلَكُوا جَمِيعاً، وَإِنْ أَخَذُوا عَلي أَيْدِيهِمْ نَجَوْا وَنَجَوْا جَمِيعاً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب هل يقرع في القسمة والاستهام فيه؟ رقم:٢٤٩٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “The example of one who abides by the commands of Allah Ta'ala and one who violates the commands of Allah Ta'ala is like people travelling on a ship! The places of the passengers were fixed by casting lots, and some were settled on the upper deck of the ship and some on the lower deck of the ship. When those on the lower deck needed water, they had to come to the upper deck and pass by those there. Those on the lower deck consulted among themselves, saying, “If we make a hole in our (lower) part (we can take water through that hole instead of going up), and we can avoid causing trouble to those on the upper deck, (how good it would be if we did this!)”. If those on the upper deck leave those on the lower deck to their wishes, (and they make the hole) the ship will sink and everyone will perish.
